observed_facts.text: Hissing and a hydrocarbon smell were observed at the PSV outlet area while operating pressure was below the set pressure; no liquid was seen.
The PSV protects V-1201; its engineer comment treats passing/weeping evidence as protection-layer impairment.

required_evidence.text: Retain the unexpected audible/smell evidence below set pressure and the relief-protection function, rather than describing nuisance noise.

expected_behavior.text: Treat evidence of suspected passing according to the equipment-specific impairment note; distinguish this concern from a proven inability to relieve pressure or a confirmed root cause.
Consider related vessel/control context without asserting these findings caused the PSV symptoms.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not call the hissing normal lifting at set pressure, invent a confirmed release rate, or claim the separator has already ruptured.

unknowns.text: Passing rate, precise cause and recorded deviation status are not supplied; absent input is not proof that no deviation exists.

action_constraints.text: Name authorized PSV passing/leak verification and integrity review of impairment status and relief disposition, without specifying unsafe live intervention.

observed_facts.text: About 12 of 60 north-quadrant nozzles had no flow or distorted spray above two producing wellheads; header pressure and flow were normal.
A later finding reports a closed north-quadrant branch valve without an impairment entry, reopened immediately; duration was unknown.

required_evidence.text: Retain impaired local delivery above producing wellheads despite normal header readings and the later valve-state evidence.

expected_behavior.text: Assess degraded wellhead fire protection and preserve chronology. The later valve finding may affect diagnosis but does not prove a sole cause or successful restored delivery.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not declare delivery satisfactory from header readings, all 60 nozzles failed, or all nozzle defects resolved by reopening the valve.

unknowns.text: The supplied records do not establish restored spray coverage, how long the valve was closed, or whether it fully explains the earlier symptoms.

action_constraints.text: Name authorized branch/nozzle inspection and a witnessed delivery-pattern retest after confirming valve alignment and addressing any remaining delivery defects, with protection-impairment review.

observed_facts.text: The duty level transmitter reads about 12 percent above the backup and 15 percent above the sight glass, diverging over three weeks; it remains in control.
The backup later flatlined for about 36 hours; the duty transmitter also feeds the high-level alarm.

required_evidence.text: Retain increasing divergence, duty control use, sight-glass comparison and the unhealthy backup; duplicated registration alone does not justify redundancy credit.

expected_behavior.text: Assess control/alarm degradation with neither leg assumed healthy; preserve the distinction between an increasing measurement error and a proved vessel-level excursion.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not recommend blindly switching control to INST-2151, state actual vessel level is 15 percent high, or assert an actual overfill.

unknowns.text: True process level, exact sensor fault, repair history and current alarm adequacy are not established by the supplied batch.

action_constraints.text: Name independent level verification and instrument calibration/loop checks on both legs with operations review before any control transfer.

observed_facts.text: The inlet deflector is partly detached after one of four brackets corroded through; shell and heads are sound, and the separator is not in service.
The test separator can be isolated and bypassed indefinitely without production impact.

required_evidence.text: Preserve actual internal damage alongside out-of-service state, sound pressure boundary and available bypass.

expected_behavior.text: Apply the domain's not-required-in-service and bypass moderation, while making clear that observed damage is real and readiness for future use needs assessment.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not assert a failed vessel shell, current platform production loss, or that the damaged internals need no repair before future use.

unknowns.text: The next required service date and engineered repair detail are not supplied; the observed bracket failure does not establish a near-term active-service demand.

action_constraints.text: Name planned inspection/repair of the deflector supports and acceptance before return to service, using the bypass context rather than inventing an immediate production shutdown.

observed_facts.text: The gauge glass is dirty and hard to read; transmitter control appears normal and no downstream carryover indications were seen.
The scrubber protects turbines from liquid carryover.

required_evidence.text: Retain reduced local visibility and the reported normal control/no-carryover observations without upgrading appearance to a proved functional failure.

expected_behavior.text: Distinguish the scrubber's potentially serious failure consequence from the limited failure evidence in this gauge-glass finding.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not claim confirmed liquid carryover, failed level control, or damaged turbines; do not claim all scrubber health is conclusively proven.

unknowns.text: The record does not establish the cause of the dirty glass or independently verify every level-control function.

action_constraints.text: Name authorized gauge-glass cleaning/restoration of readability and a local level-indication comparison, not an unsupported vessel replacement.

observed_facts.text: The backup level reading has been flat for about 36 hours, implausible for the service; blocked impulse line or sensor failure is suspected.
The duty transmitter has growing disagreement with the sight glass and backup while remaining in control.

required_evidence.text: Retain the flatline duration and the unhealthy duty leg so the duplicated arrangement is not treated as verified healthy redundancy.

expected_behavior.text: Assess loss of credible backup measurement without claiming the sensor root cause is proven or that actual level remained constant.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not declare the duty instrument a healthy alternative, actual vessel level constant for 36 hours, or a blocked impulse line confirmed.

unknowns.text: The cause of the flatline, true level, restoration status and approved control/alarm arrangement are not supplied.

action_constraints.text: Name authorized impulse-line/sensor and loop checks plus independent level verification coordinated with the duty-leg assessment.

observed_facts.text: The north-quadrant deluge branch isolation valve was chained closed without a status tag or impairment entry; it was reopened immediately and the control room informed.
Earlier testing found impaired nozzle delivery above two producing wellheads.

required_evidence.text: Retain explicit missing impairment entry, reopened state and unknown closure duration; connect the earlier failed delivery without assuming it is resolved.

expected_behavior.text: The unlogged impairment at discovery calls for immediate action under the domain rule. For this draft, require immediate human review of unverified current protection after reopening; do not presume continuing total defeat or restored delivery.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not claim the valve remains closed, the closure duration is known, reopening proves healthy nozzle delivery, or the closed valve definitively caused every earlier spray defect.

unknowns.text: Current delivered coverage, closure duration and causal relation to the earlier test are unknown. Missing entry at discovery is explicit, unlike a merely unprovided register.

action_constraints.text: Name impairment/deviation reconciliation, valve-state verification and a witnessed north-quadrant delivery test before treating the protection concern as closed.

observed_facts.text: Insulation around the separator manway is damp/stained with rust staining below cladding; the underlying surface is not visible without insulation removal.
The separator is the first-stage pressure boundary; the engineer comment requires integrity review for even small wall-loss, cracking or weeping indications.

required_evidence.text: Retain concealed wet/rust evidence and pressure-boundary role while distinguishing a suspected mechanism from measured wall loss.

expected_behavior.text: Use integrity review and targeted inspection to resolve uncertainty; historical reliability does not negate new pressure-boundary concern. Do not infer the PSV or transmitter symptoms caused this condition.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not claim measured thickness below minimum, a confirmed leak/crack, or a sound hidden surface that has not been inspected.

unknowns.text: Underlying condition, remaining thickness, extent and degradation rate are not supplied.

action_constraints.text: Name integrity-engineer review, authorized local insulation removal and targeted wall-thickness/condition inspection around the manway.
